findings.evidence: Approach: black box; positive and negative cases; boundary value analysis; equivalence partitioning.
findings.fix: Keep the section as the full-plan shape users ask for, but replace the named ISTQB techniques with the plan-specific choices this skill already makes (oracles before steps, evidence-backed exclusions, Unknown for missing facts); record the generic technique names in docs/audit/recovery/qa-test-planner/record.md if they leave the file.

findings.evidence: Not for Cypress, Playwright, unit or API automation, fixing implementation code, or any QA request that does not name this skill.
findings.fix: Create manual QA test plans, executable test cases, regression and smoke suites, a ship-or-block release decision, Figma design-validation checklists and structured bug reports (repro rate, environment, Open Questions). Use when the user invokes qa-test-planner by name or /qa-test-planner, including a request that only implies the deliverable once the name is present: a password-reset or checkout plan, cases for a flow, a smoke or targeted suite, a ship-or-block decision, a Figma frame comparison, or a bug whose rate or browser is unknown. Not for Cypress, Playwright, unit or API automation, or fixing implementation code.

findings.evidence: For a complete worked case (a login case, a mobile navigation UI case), read `references/test_case_examples.md`.
findings.fix: Add to that sentence: Do NOT load `references/test_case_examples.md` when the request only asks for cases, not a complete worked example; the base format in `references/test_case_templates.md` is enough.

findings.evidence: Ask only when two rows fit and the choice changes the work (a bug report versus cases for the same symptom). Otherwise take the row and say which one you took.
findings.fix: Name the default when two rows fit and the user is not present to answer: if the request names a defect, rate, or observed failure, take the bug-report row; if it asks to verify or cover a flow, take the cases row; say which row you took.

Point each eval's files array only at fixtures under evals/files/ (keep release-2-4-changes.md, checkout-bug-notes.md, and the bug-run and case-run logs). The references the skill already tells the agent to read are not eval inputs; leave the assertions as they are.

findings.evidence: "regression", "smoke", "what to retest after X" | Prioritized suite and run report | `references/regression_testing.md`
findings.fix: In the regression row, say a request that only asks which tiers exist, when each runs, or how to find critical paths stops after `references/regression_testing.md` (Suite tiers, Build the suite) and does not also emit a run report; emit the run report only when the request supplies results or asks for the release decision.

Replace the attack-vector checklist with the observable assertion already in SKILL.md section 4: the case states the refusal, that no session or record changes, and that no error detail leaks, using only a dedicated test account and disposable data. Do not list exploit payloads or injection classes for the agent to attempt.
